description: A professional competency framework developed by the UK Haemophilia Nurses Association that defines five domains and four practice levels for assessing and supporting the development of haemophilia specialist nurses.
title: UK Haemophilia Nurses Association competency framework

description: A secure, governed UK database linking medical students' and postgraduate trainees' sociodemographic, educational and assessment records for medical-education research and differential-attainment analysis.
title: UK Medical Education Database (UKMED)

description: A 29-competency framework developed by the UK Obesity Care Competencies Working Group to guide multidisciplinary healthcare professionals' specialist obesity-care training and practice.
title: UK Obesity Care Competencies framework

description: A five-domain framework of 29 obesity-care competencies developed by the UK Obesity Care Competencies Working Group for selecting and assessing competencies relevant to health professionals in specialist obesity services.
title: UK Obesity Care Competencies Working Group's 29 core obesity care competencies

description: A prospective, anonymized multi-cohort dataset linking UKCAT scores, prior attainment, demographic and contextual measures, and first-year medical-school outcomes, assembled by the UKCAT Consortium and participating UK medical schools.
title: UKCAT-12 collaborative dataset of 4,811 students across 12 UK medical schools
